blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omni LLMs can naturally locate key audio and visual evidence and integrate information across modalities for audiovisual reasoning. Existing audio-visual reasoning benchmarks that mainly rely on multiple-choice questions usually score models solely based on answer correctness, making it difficult to assess whether a model truly forms a reasoning chain from evidence to the correct answer. In addition, textual or unimodal shortcuts may allow models to answer correctly without analyzing the necessary audio-visual evidence, further weakening the reliability of evaluation benchmarks. To address these issues, we introduce EvaOmni, an evidence-grounded benchmark containing 392 videos and 1,027 purely human-annotated question-answer pairs, covering 15 capabilities and three levels: retrieval and localization, basic understanding, and complex reasoning. We design a series of rigorous annotation procedures in which experts annotate audio and visual evidence and construct video-based distractors; humans review whether questions meet strict inspection criteria, and finally models filter textual and unimodal shortcuts. Beyond high-quality question-answer pairs, we require models to simultaneously return the answer and supporting evidence intervals in order to evaluate the complete reasoning chain. We propose the Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.) to measure how much annotated evidence a model identifies, and the Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.) to penalize poor temporal localization in either modality; both are incorporated into answer correctness. Across 7 open-weight and 17 proprietary Omni LLMs, Gemini3.7-Flash achieved the highest overall accuracy (79.4%), C.G. (70.8%), and B.G. (35.1%). At Level 3, it reached 79.1% accuracy, but its B.G. was only 12.3%. These results show that even the most advanced models still have room for development in grounded audio-visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: Omni LLMS可以自然地找到关键的视听证据,并整合各种视听推理方式的信息. 现有的主要依靠多选题的视听推理基准通常只根据答案正确性来评分模型,因此很难评估一个模型是否真的形成了从证据到正确答案的推理链. 此外,文字或单式快捷方式可能使模型在不分析必要的视听证据的情况下正确回答,从而进一步削弱了评价基准的可靠性。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了EvaOmni,这是一个循证基准,包含392个视频和1 027个纯粹人为附加说明的对答,涵盖15个能力和三个层面:检索和本地化、基本理解和复杂的推理。 我们设计了一系列严格的注释程序,专家们在其中对视听证据进行注释,并构建基于视频的分辨器;人类审查问题是否符合严格的检查标准,最后模拟过滤文本和单模式快捷方式。 除了高质量的问答对,我们需要模型同时返回答案和辅助证据间隔,以便评价完整的推理链. 我们提议采用 " 覆盖基准计分 " (C.G.)来衡量一个模型所识别的附加说明的证据,以及 " Bottleneck基准计分 " (B.G.)来惩罚两种模式中时间定位不当的现象;两者都纳入了答案正确性。 在7个开放重量级和17个专有Omni LLMs中,双子座3.7-Flash达到了最高的总体精度(79.4%),C.G.(70.8%)和B.G.(35.1%)。 在3级,它达到了79.1%的精确度,但其B.G.仅为12.3%。 这些结果表明,即使是最先进的模型,在有根据的视听推理中,仍然有发展的余地。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Omni-modal large language models (Omni LLMs) [ 32 , 33 , 25 , 5 ] can jointly process text, audio, images, and video, integrating cross-modal cues to interpret multimodal inputs and reason over the evidence they provide. Audio-visual reasoning in video scenarios is particularly difficult because it requires models to connect and analyze auditory and visual signals simultaneously. This involves identifying relevant evidence in each modality and integrating cues from different moments, abilities that support applications such as sports event understanding and the analysis of films and television programs. With the rapid development of Omni LLMs, accurately and reliably evaluating the capabilities of existing Omni LLMs has become particularly important, and is of great significance for identifying model shortcomings and driving their development.
blocks.zh: Omni-module大型语言模型(Omni LLMs)[32,33,25,5]可以联合处理文本,音频,图像和视频,整合跨模式提示,以解释其所提供的证据的多式联运投入和理由. 视频情景中的视听推理尤其困难,因为它需要模型同时连接和分析听觉和视觉信号. 这包括确定每一种模式的相关证据,整合不同时刻的提示、支持体育赛事理解等应用的能力以及对电影和电视节目的分析。 随着Omni LLMs的迅速发展,准确和可靠地评价现有Omni LLMs的能力变得特别重要,对于查明模型缺陷和推动其发展具有重大意义.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks for joint audio-visual reasoning [ 36 , 14 , 16 , 2 , 22 , 31 ] cover everyday activities, real-world scenarios, and diverse tasks, providing valuable ways to assess Omni LLMs. However, our analysis reveals a key limitation of dominant multiple-choice question (MCQ) evaluations: a correct answer does not necessarily demonstrate joint use of audio and visual evidence . As illustrated in Fig. 1 , some questions can be answered using a single modality or even textual cues alone. This ambiguity has two sources. First, answer-only scoring cannot distinguish evidence-supported answers from lucky guesses. Second, question and answer-option design can introduce unimodal or logical (text) shortcuts. For example, the correct option may be inferred from common knowledge, audio-only input, or vision-only input. Quantitative visualizations from existing benchmarks are provided in the Appendix D.1 . Together, these limitations motivate an evaluation protocol that requires models to identify the audio and visual evidence supporting each answer, enabling a complete evaluation of the entire reasoning chain.
blocks.zh: 视听联合推理的现有基准[36、14、16、2、22、31]涵盖日常活动、现实世界情景和各种任务,为评估Omni LLM提供了宝贵的途径。 然而,我们的分析揭示了主导性多选择问题(MCQ)评价的关键局限:正确答案并不一定表明视听证据的共同使用。 如图1所示,有些问题可以单用单一模式甚至文字提示回答。 这种模糊性有两个来源。 首先,只有答案的评分无法区分证据支持的答案和幸运猜想. 第二,问答选项设计可以引入单式或逻辑(文本)快捷键. 例如,正确的选项可以从常识中推断出来,只有音频输入,或者只有视觉输入. 附录D.1提供了现有基准的可视化量。 这些局限性加在一起,激发了一个评价协议,要求模型识别支持每个答案的音频和视觉证据,从而能够对整个推理链进行完整的评价.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Existing audio-visual reasoning benchmarks suffer from shortcut issues, which weaken the reliability of benchmark evaluation. EvaOmni greatly reduces this phenomenon through a series of rigorous annotation procedures and a grounded evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 图1 现有视听推理基准存在捷径问题,削弱了基准评价的可靠性. EvaOmni通过一系列严格的注释程序和有根据的评价协议,大大减少了这一现象.

blocks.en: Motivated by these observations, we introduce EvaOmni , an EV idence-grounded benchmark for A udio-visual reasoning. It comprises 392 videos and 1,027 question-answer pairs spanning 15 fine-grained capabilities at three levels of reasoning and evidence complexity: Level 1-Retrieval & Grounding requires locating relevant audio and visual evidence; Level 2-Basic Understanding requires interpreting and combining complementary cues; and Level 3-Complex Reasoning requires understanding with complex evidence distribution, or performing multi-step cross-modal reasoning. Experts need to annotate the audio and visual intervals supporting each answer, and models must return both an answer and its supporting intervals. This design both greatly reduces annotation errors and prevents models from using shortcuts when answering questions. To ensure question quality, we designed a series of rigorous annotation procedures: systematic video selection, expert annotation, cross-checking, and model-assisted filtering. These procedures help reduce text and unimodal shortcuts. Such procedures ensure the high quality and reliability of our questions. We also propose two new evaluation metrics: the Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.) , which measures the coverage of annotated evidence identified by the model, and the Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.) , which penalizes inaccurate temporal localization in either modality. Both incorporate answer correctness to comprehensively evaluate the model’s reasoning ability. Additional grounded metrics are reported in the Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们引入了EvaOmni,一个基于EV的基于EV的视听推理基准. 包括392个视频和1 027个问答对,涉及15个精细的推理和证据复杂程度: 一级检索和地平线需要找到相关的视听证据; 二级基本理解需要解释和结合互补提示; 三级复合理性需要理解复杂的证据分布,或进行多步骤的跨模式推理. 专家需要注释支持每个答案的音频和视觉间隔,模型必须同时返回一个答案及其支持间隔. 这种设计既能大大减少注释错误,又能防止模型在回答问题时使用快捷键. 为了确保问题的质量,我们设计了一系列严格的注释程序:系统视频选择、专家注释、交叉检查和模型辅助过滤。 这些程序有助于减少文本和单式快捷方式。 这些程序确保我们提出的问题的质量和可靠性。 我们还提出两个新的评价衡量标准:衡量模型所查明的附加说明证据的覆盖率的 " 覆盖基准计分 " (C.G.)和惩罚两种模式中不准确的时间定位的 " Bottleneck Globed S.G. blocks.en: We conduct a systematic evaluation of EvaOmni, involving seven open-weight models and 17 proprietary Omni LLMs. The best-performing proprietary model, Gemini3.7-Flash, achieves 79.4% accuracy, 70.8% C.G., and 35.1% B.G. overall. The strongest open-weight model, MiMo-V2.5-310B-A15B, achieves 56.8% accuracy, 48.4% C.G., and 20.5% B.G. Gemini3.7-Flash leads by 22.6, 22.4, and 14.6 percentage points, respectively. Relative to Qwen3-Omni-Instruct-30B-A3B (25.2% accuracy, 4.0% C.G., and 0.4% B.G.), MiMo-V2.5-310B-A15B scores 2.3, 12.1, and 51.3 times as high on these metrics, respectively. Despite this progress, the strongest proprietary models remain well below the human reference in localization quality: Gemini3.7-Flash achieves 35.1% B.G., compared with 94.3% for human experts. These findings demonstrate the importance of grounded evaluation, which cannot be captured by previous MCQ-based benchmarks. We hope EvaOmni brings some new insights to the development of omni-modal models: future models should not only pursue correct answers but also be able to precisely localize the evidence supporting their answers, so that their conclusions can be verified against the audio-visual input. We have publicly released EvaOmni, including its data, annotations, and evaluation framework, to support reliable, interpretable, and hierarchical evaluation of audio-visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们对EvaOmni进行系统评估,涉及7个开放量级模型和17个专有Omni有限责任公司。 表现最好的专有型号双子座3.7-Flash达到79.4%的精度,70.8%的C.G.和35.1%的B.G. 最强的开放量级模型米莫-V2.5-310B-A15B的精度分别达到56.8%,48.4%C.G,20.5%B.G.双子座3.7-Flash分别领先22.6,22.4和14.6个百分点. 相对于Qune3-Omni-Instruct-30B-A3B(25.2%的精度,4.0%的C.G,和0.4%的B.G),米莫-V2.5-310B-A15B在这些度量衡上分别得分2.3,12.1,51.3倍. 尽管取得了这一进展,但最强的专利模式在本地化质量方面仍然远远低于人类参考:双子座3.7-Flash达到了35.1%的B.G.,而人类专家则为94.3%。 这些调查结果表明,有根据的评价十分重要,以往基于监测、业绩和业绩审查的基准无法反映这一点。 我们希望EvaOmni为开发全方位模式带来一些新的见解:未来的模式不仅应追求正确的答案,而且还应能够精确地将支持其答案的证据本地化,从而能够根据视听投入来验证其结论. 我们公开发布了EvaOmni,包括其数据、说明和评价框架,以支持对视听推理的可靠、可解释和分级评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Omni LLMs. Omni LLMs process text, images, video, and audio, enabling cross-modal understanding and reasoning [ 6 , 7 , 17 ] . ImageBind [ 8 ] learned shared representations across text, audio, depth, and images; PandaGPT [ 21 ] connected such representations to an LLM; and NExT-GPT [ 29 ] extended omni-modal systems to image, audio, and video generation. GPT-4o [ 15 ] introduced streaming speech generation for natural interaction. The Gemini [ 23 , 24 , 4 ] and Qwen [ 32 , 33 , 25 ] families are leading proprietary and open-weight Omni LLMs, respectively, advancing cross-modal understanding and reasoning. SeedRealtime [ 1 ] further integrates audio, video, and text in a full-duplex architecture for continuous scene understanding, interaction-timing awareness, and responsive behavior. Together, these systems mark a shift toward joint reasoning and natural interaction.
blocks.zh: Omni LLMs. Omni LLMs 处理文本,图像,视频和音频,实现跨模式理解和推理 [6, 7, 17]. ImageBind[8]在文本、音频、深度和图像方面学到了共享的表达方式;PandaGPT[21]将这种表达方式与LLM连接起来;NExT-GPT[29]将全方位模式系统扩展到图像、音频和视频生成。 GPT-4o [15]引入流体语音生成用于自然互动. 双子座[23,24,4]和Quen[32,33,25]家族分别是独资和开放重量的Omni LLMs家族,推动跨模式理解和推理. 种子Realtime [1] 进一步将音频,视频,文本整合到一个全复式架构中,用于持续的场景理解,互动激励意识,以及反应行为. 这些系统共同标志着向联合推理和自然互动的转变。

blocks.en: Benchmarks for Omni LLMs. Unlike benchmarks of individual image, audio, or video understanding [ 20 , 27 , 3 , 34 , 28 , 35 ] , Omni LLM benchmarks assess joint cross-modal reasoning. DailyOmni [ 36 ] covers everyday scenarios; WorldSense [ 14 ] emphasizes audio-visual understanding in real-world videos; and OmniVideoBench [ 16 ] requires reasoning over both modalities. Yet text and unimodal shortcuts can undermine answer-only scores, and existing benchmarks do not jointly score answer correctness and the localization of supporting audio-visual evidence. Another evaluation approach, Open-Ended, relies on judge models and is thus insufficiently objective and convenient. Therefore, the research community currently urgently needs an evaluation system that is objective, convenient, and rigorous.
blocks.zh: 与个人图像、音频或视频理解的基准不同[20、27、3、34、28、35],Omni LLM基准评估联合跨模式推理。 DailyOmni [36] 涵盖日常情景;WorldSense [14] 强调在现实世界视频中的视听理解;OmniVideo Bench [16] 要求对两种模式进行推理. 然而,文本和单模式快捷方式可能会破坏只答的分数,而现有的基准并不共同得分答案正确性和辅助视听证据的本地化. 另一种评价方式,即 " 不限 " ,依赖法官模式,因此不够客观和方便。 因此,研究界目前迫切需要一个客观、方便和严格的评价制度。

blocks.en: 3.2 Introducing EvaOmni
blocks.zh: 3.2 介绍埃瓦奥姆尼

blocks.en: To address RQ3, we introduce EvaOmni , an evidence-grounded benchmark for audio-visual reasoning. For each question, expert annotators identify the audio and visual intervals supporting the correct answer. At evaluation time, models must provide both an answer and timestamped evidence intervals for each modality. EvaOmni evaluates answer correctness together with evidence coverage and temporal grounding, thereby limiting the credit awarded to correct answers that lack matching evidence. Text-only, audio-only, and vision-only checks during question construction further reduce shortcut susceptibility, as described below. EvaOmni organizes 15 fine-grained capabilities into three levels of reasoning and evidence complexity:
blocks.zh: 为了解决RQ3问题,我们引入了EvaOmni,这是一个基于证据的视听推理基准. 对于每个问题,专家的注释员都确定支持正确答案的音频和视觉间隔. 在评价时,模型必须提供每种模式的答案和时间标记的证据间隔。 EvaOmni评估正确性以及证据覆盖面和时间依据,从而将判给的信用限制在缺乏相应证据的正确答案上。 如下文所述,在问题构建过程中,只用文本、只用音频和仅用视觉的检查进一步减少了快捷方式的易感性。 EvaOmni将15个精细的精细能力组织成三个层次的推理和证据复杂性:

blocks.en: Level 1: Retrieval and Grounding. Tests temporal alignment, event binidng, and entity binding, such as identifying the speaker of an utterance or linking a sound to its visible source.
blocks.zh: 一级:检索和地面。 测试时间对齐,事件binidng,以及实体绑定,例如识别一个语音的扬声器,或者将一个声音与其可见源连接.

blocks.en: Level 2: Basic Understanding. Requires models to interpret and integrate complementary audio-visual cues to understand events, scene context, and their relationships.
blocks.zh: 第二级:基本理解。 要求模型解释和整合互补的视听提示,以了解事件、场景背景及其关系。

blocks.en: Level 3: Complex Reasoning. Tests long-range reasoning, multi-evidence chains, and multi-hop reasoning. These tasks require models to integrate evidence from different moments, perform multiple inference steps, or both.
blocks.zh: 第3级:复杂原因。 测试远程推理,多证据链,以及多跳推理. 这些任务需要模型整合不同时刻的证据,执行多个推断步骤,或者两者兼而有之.

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: To mitigate potential training data contamination, we collect recent videos from open platforms such as YouTube and Bilibili. The selected 1–12-minute videos span diverse real-world scenarios and contain informative visual events and audio cues. We exclude videos with hard-coded subtitles or prominent textual overlays to limit OCR-based shortcuts. Detailed selection and screening criteria are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 为了减少潜在的培训数据污染,我们收集了YouTube和bilibili等开放平台的最新视频。 所选的1至12分钟的视频覆盖了不同的现实世界情景,包含内容丰富的视觉事件和音频提示. 我们排除带有硬码字幕或显著文字覆盖的视频,以限制基于OCR的快捷键. 附录A提供了详细的甄选和筛选标准。

blocks.en: 3.4 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.4 注释管道

blocks.en: Expert annotators construct questions requiring joint use of audio and visual information and mark the temporal evidence for each modality. Each sample then undergoes human cross-validation for capability alignment, evidence quality, and potential textual or unimodal shortcuts. Disputed pairs receive independent review by two additional experts and are discarded unless both approve them. Model-assisted screening under text-only, audio-only, and visual-only inputs identifies additional shortcuts; pairs flagged at this stage are revised and re-evaluated. Appendix A provides the full annotation and quality-control procedure.
blocks.zh: 专家注释员提出问题,需要共同使用视听信息,并标出每种方式的时间证据。 然后,每个样本都经过人力交叉验证,以便进行能力调整、证据质量以及潜在的文字或单模式快捷方式。 争议的对夫妇由另外两名专家进行独立审查,除非双方都批准,否则将被抛弃。 模式辅助放映仅限文本,只限音频,只限视觉输入,可识别额外快捷方式;在此阶段标注的对子进行修改和重新评价. 附 录 A提供了完整的注释和质量控制程序。

blocks.en:
Analysis Across Capability Levels. Answer accuracy decreases from
Level 1 to Level 2 for 21 of the 24 models, but increases from Level 2 to
Level 3 for 13 models. For example, Gemini3.7-Flash improves from 73.6%
to 79.1% accuracy between Levels 2 and 3, while its C.G. drops from
65.3% to 49.1% and B.G. from 29.2% to 12.3%. This divergence is consistent with the design of Level 3, which emphasizes
long-range reasoning, combinations of multiple evidence segments, and
multi-hop inference. These tasks place greater demands on assembling and
localizing supporting evidence, without necessarily producing a monotonic
decline in multiple-choice accuracy. One plausible explanation is that
partial evidence can help eliminate distractors and narrow the candidate
set, allowing a model to select the correct answer without fully localizing
the supporting evidence. The aggregate results are compatible with this
explanation, but do not directly establish the models’ answer-selection
strategies. In contrast, Level 3 yields the lowest B.G. for all 24 models, including
one tie, and the lowest C.G. for all 24 models. This broad trend across
open-weight and proprietary models highlights the value of grounded
evaluation: C.G. rewards evidence coverage alongside correct answers,
whereas B.G. rewards accurate temporal localization in both modalities
alongside correct answers. Reporting Acc. together with these two metrics
therefore provides a more complete assessment of answering, evidence
coverage, and precise grounding across capability levels.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce EvaOmni, a new evidence-grounded benchmark for audio-visual reasoning. Rather than evaluating only whether a model selects the correct answer, EvaOmni also requires the model to identify the supporting evidence necessary to justify its prediction. Through a series of rigorous annotation and quality-control procedures, EvaOmni comprises 1,027 questions organized into three hierarchical levels, providing diverse scenarios and rich data for comprehensive evaluation. We further introduce multiple Grounded Score metrics to evaluate the accuracy of evidence localization. Among them, the Coverage Grounded Score rewards evidence coverage, while the Bottleneck Grounded Score prevents strong localization in one modality from masking failure in the other. Additional Grounded Score variants are provided in the Appendix. Large-scale evaluation shows that combining grounded evaluation with accuracy reveals insights missed by accuracy alone. EvaOmni provides a reproducible, interpretable basis for measuring progress and identifies precise temporal grounding as the capability current Omni LLMs most clearly lack. We have fully released the data, annotations, and evaluation framework, and we hope they will serve as a valuable resource for the research community to advance the development of Omni LLMs.

EVAOmni通过一系列严格的注释和质量控制程序,由1 027个问题组成,分为三个层次,为综合评价提供了不同的情景和丰富的数据。 我们进一步采用了多个基于分数的衡量标准,以评估证据本地化的准确性。 其中, " 覆盖基础分数 " 奖励证据覆盖面,而 " Bottleneck基础分数 " 防止一种方式的强烈本地化掩盖另一种方式的失败。 附录中提供了其他基于分数的变体。 大规模评价表明,将有根据的评价与准确性结合起来,就可以看出光是准确性就错过了见解。 EvaOmni为衡量进展提供了可复制和可解释的基础,并确定了目前Omni LLMs最明显缺乏的能力的准确时间基础。 我们已充分公布数据、说明和评价框架,我们希望它们将成为研究界推动Omni LLMs发展的宝贵资源。

dimensions: 1. Capability alignment: whether the question matches its
assigned fine-grained capability and capability level. 2. Shortcut susceptibility: whether the question can be
reliably answered using only the question and options, audio alone,
or vision alone through logical or unimodal cues. 3. Evidence quality: whether the audio and visual evidence
intervals and descriptions are accurate and support the annotated
answer. Approximately 78% of the initially submitted pairs pass this first review.

pair is discarded if either additional expert identifies a problem; it passes
only if both approve it. Overall, approximately 82% of the initially
submitted pairs pass human cross-validation, while the remaining 18% are
discarded at this stage.

blocks.en: B.2 Human Expert Baseline
blocks.zh: B.2 人权专家基线

blocks.en:
The human expert baseline is obtained from test participants who are
independent of the annotators who constructed the questions and marked the
reference evidence. They answer the same questions using the same test videos
as the models and report supporting audio and visual intervals; their
responses are scored using the same Acc., C.G., and B.G. metrics. Participants
may pause and replay the videos when answering and locating evidence. This
allowance helps compensate for human memory, which is much more limited than a
model’s access to the supplied video context, but it also makes the viewing
protocol different from model inference. Even with replay, the need to retain
and revisit details across a video may disadvantage humans, especially for
long or temporally dispersed evidence. We therefore treat the human scores as
a reference baseline rather than a strictly matched comparison of memory or
viewing conditions.

blocks.en: D.4 Analysis Across Fine-Grained Capabilities

blocks.en: Figure 31 compares the two representative models across 15 fine-grained capabilities. On the three Level 1 alignment tasks, Gemini3.7-Flash achieves 82.3%–88.8% accuracy and 47.5%–49.9% B.G., compared with 60.4%–68.8% accuracy and 28.1%–34.0% B.G. for MiMo-V2.5. Both models show a larger separation between answering and precise grounding on complex tasks. On multi-hop reasoning, Gemini3.7-Flash reaches 80.7% accuracy but only 10.6% B.G., while MiMo-V2.5 reaches 44.6% accuracy and 4.9% B.G.; on multi-evidence chains, the corresponding scores are 82.9%/15.6% and 51.4%/8.2%. These comparisons suggest that selecting an answer is substantially easier for both models than locating the dispersed evidence needed to support it.

blocks.en: E.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: E.1 限制

blocks.en:
Dataset coverage. EvaOmni contains 1,027 question-answer pairs drawn from 392 videos lasting
1–12 minutes with sufficient audio-visual cues. Excluding hard-coded
subtitles and prioritizing varied entities and events support the
construction of questions requiring both modalities, but also constrain
the data distribution. The results therefore do not establish
generalization to substantially longer videos, subtitle-rich content,
scenes with sparse events, or all linguistic and cultural contexts.
The three capability levels characterize different task requirements;
they do not guarantee a strictly increasing difficulty ordering in
answer accuracy across different question sets.

blocks.en: E.2 Future Work

blocks.en:
Broader data and task coverage. Future extensions could include longer videos, a wider range of
linguistic and cultural contexts, and scenes with sparser audio-visual
cues while retaining checks for the necessity of both modalities.
Subtitle-rich content would also enable explicit separation of text
reading from audio understanding. Broader evaluation of open-ended
question answering could test whether the current findings hold
without cues from answer options.
